# PR #4122: Patch: daily super run failed

Closes #4079

## Summary

This fixes the failed jobs of super run 43911818437 except the daily tests job, which needs a one-line `super.yml` change a person must make (quoted below). Root-causing each job found six engine, monitor or client bugs, one runaway card interaction and two tests that could overrun their own limits. **The daily tests job still fails** until that edit lands. No test was skipped, ignored or loosened.

Three passes built this. Pass 1 wrote plan steps 1–18. Pass 2 fixed its compile and test slips, found the cause of e2e (8/8) and removed the patch fragment. Pass 3, this one, fixed the one red check left.

## What changed, by job

| Job | Root cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| **fuzz (1/4)**, plain seed 1013 | False I2 alarm. An animated Fiery Waraxe that attacked twice under a Windfury aura and ended the action back in its backrow was not read as a gone unit (R383, R636). | `InvariantMonitor`, `AttackDeclared` arm (`crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`). Tests are in `crates/cards/tests/cross/invariants.rs`; the second one keeps the violation firing with no aura. |
| **fuzz (4/4)**, Duos seed 1778 | False I2 alarm. A Drone Corvette that drew its keywords and was gone by the end of the action may have drawn Frenzy (R3543003, R781004). | `Destroyed` arm of the same monitor, plus two tests. The no-kill test still fires. |
| **fuzz (4/4)**, Duos seed 1616 | Engine bug (I6). Bogos Binted's Cry keeps a side snapshot in card memory. `rename_in_board_history` did not rename inside it, so a trap set again under a fresh id came back under its old id as a second copy. | `crates/engine/src/state.rs`: a new `rename_in_side`, also applied to each `@sideSnapshot` note, which is written back only when something was renamed. Test `r227_r3550007_…` in `tests/rules/combat_reactions.rs`. |
| **fuzz (4/4)**, handicapped seed 9203 | Deadman's Hand copies let the Hard AI cast Unsecure System ten times. Attack reached 3,066, past `GROWTH_NUMBER_BOUND` (2,000). | New ruling **R4079000**: a doubling or tripling stops at `MULTIPLIED_STAT_CAP` = 999 (in `crates/engine/src/config.rs`). Applied to S #119 Unsecure System and S #10.2 Divine Spirit. The old scripts are kept as `script_v0_6_6d` in `KEPT_SCRIPTS`, so older replays still fold (R767000). Each card has cap tests and a kept-version test. |
| **e2e (2/8)**, spec 48 | Clicking a Tribute unit while the play needed only its zone added the tribute again, so the play never finished. | `actions.ts` `onClickTarget`: such a click now answers the zone (R3864000, R391, R446). Tests are in `actions.test.ts`. |
| **e2e (7/8)**, spec 42 | The tavern shell is its own stacking context, so its dialog scrim sat under #4068's toasts. | `dialog.css`: `.tavern.app-shell:has(> .dialog-scrim)` takes `--z-dialog` (R3220000). Test in `Dialog.test.tsx`. |
| **e2e (8/8)** | Spec 51 signed in as p1 for all seven sizes, past R109's 300 requests a minute. Spec 55 runs next in shard 8 and got a 429 on its first read. Running 51 then 55 reproduced it; 55 alone passes. | `51-menu-shell.cy.ts` now signs in as p1 to p4 in turn, one per size, as spec 38 does. |
| **component (3/3)**, practice-table at 768x1024 | At game end the opponent's hand turns face up (R434). In tablet portrait the board then ran 92 px past its box and put the control bar under the result chip. | `board.css`: on an ended tablet-portrait board, the field rows give that height back. Test in `Hand.test.tsx`. |
| **component (2/3)**, deckbuilder-layout | `fitEveryPoolCard` walked all 799 pool cards inside one 60 s `cy.then` and took 58–65 s. | The walk is split into commands of 40 rows each (`ROWS_PER_WALK`), each with its own 60 s. Every stop, both frames per stop and every assertion are kept. |
| **daily tests** | `fuzz_daily_top_up::the_days_extra_seeds_keep_every_pool_card_s_deals_as_the_pool_grows`: 799 cards need 12,465 seeds and super.yml plays 10,000. | **A person must edit `.github/workflows/super.yml`** (below). |

### The `super.yml` edit a person must make

I can't change `.github/`. In `.github/workflows/super.yml`, change:

```yaml
FUZZ_SEEDS: "10000"
```
to
```yaml
FUZZ_SEEDS: "13000"
```

13,000 seeds cover a pool of up to 833 cards, and the 300-seed top-up then reaches 852. Each fuzz shard would play 3,250 seeds per wave: about 35 minutes in release at `fuzz.rs`'s recorded rates, inside the job's 90-minute limit. Optionally also update the "`fuzz --seeds 10000`" comment further down the file and the "10,000" in `bot/go/internal/dashboard/runners.go`.

No honest change outside `.github/` fixes this. A larger `DAILY_TOP_UP_MAX` overruns the job's 60 minutes (#4035), and a smaller `DAILY_DEALS_PER_CARD` weakens the check.

## Review findings for this pass

**Red check `web tests`, `switchReason.test.tsx` "R3821000 a spent unit's click still reaches its zone while a play onto that zone is built": held, fixed.**
- **Cause:** the new branch in `onClickTarget` answered a play's zone for a click on any of your units. A unit card that is not lit as legal but has a reason to show (R3821000) does not stop the click (`Card.tsx`, `fire`). So the click went on to the zone as well, and the play was sent twice.
- **Fix:** the branch now also requires `someCandidateFixesTribute(interaction, target.instanceId)`.
  - A unit the play tributes is lit, so its click stops at the card. That is spec 48's case, which still needs the branch.
  - Any other unit's click goes on to its zone as before, and only the zone plays.

## How it was tested

**This pass, after the fix:**
- **Web tests:** the harness's `--changed origin/main` vitest command passes 308 files and 6,780 tests (139 skipped). `switchReason`, `actions`, `sick`, `Dialog` and `Hand` pass (127 tests).
- **Checks:** eslint on `actions.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` are clean.
- **Replays and fuzz:** `cargo jackioh golden check` folds the hotseat fixture to `512357ea`. `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` gives 200 passed, 0 failed, 0 invariant violations and 0 past a growth bound.
- **Spec and catalog:** `spec check`, `patches check` and `catalog check` all pass.
- **Daily suite** (`cargo test --workspace --tests --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts -- --ignored`):
  - Every daily test passes except the top-up test above, which fails with its `FUZZ_SEEDS` message.
  - Cargo stopped at that failing binary, so I ran the last two files that hold daily tests separately: `-p jackioh-tools --test perf --test acceptance -- --ignored`. `perf`'s daily test passed; `acceptance.rs` holds none.
  - Its first attempt failed to compile (E0425) because cargo reused a stale engine build. This worktree shares `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` with the harness's base worktree at `main`. Touching the engine's sources made cargo rebuild it, and the rerun compiled. No source changed.

**Pass 2:**
- **Fuzz seeds:** the four seeds pass. Seed 9203's largest number is now 996.
- **Wider fuzz sweep:** seeds 10001–13000, the ones a 13,000 `FUZZ_SEEDS` adds, pass 3,000 of 3,000 plain and 3,000 of 3,000 handicapped.
- **New tests:** each fails without its fix. That was checked for the three monitor and state tests and for the R3864000 web test (against `main`'s code), and for the practice-table layout at 768x1024 (against `main`'s `board.css`).
- **Component specs:** deckbuilder-layout (32 tests), practice-table (38) and mobile-ux (87) pass.
- **E2E:**
  - Spec 42 passes, spec 48 passes, and shard 8 passes in full with the spec 51 fix.
  - Shard 7 passes on a fresh server. One run of spec 42's first test needed a retry: the challenger did not follow, joining 42 ms after the create (a possible race in `ChallengeToast`'s follow against the live socket, R3214000). I did not fix it.
- **Shard 2:** run, but no result was recorded.

## Decisions

- **The cap is 999,** the planner's value. It is far above any number a game reaches without such a chain.
  - Rejected: raising `GROWTH_NUMBER_BOUND` or measuring growth per action, which would weaken the runaway-scaling check.
  - Rejected: capping every stat, which would change every Buff to fix two cards.
- **No patch fragment.** `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`, with a base build as the parent, refutes plays for both cards because forced games of them play as before (R1370000). A fragment that claims nothing is refused. classify is clean (`classify: App`). The `KEPT_SCRIPTS` rows stay, per `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §3.
- **The kept version is v0.6.6d,** the newest shipped patch when this was built. The plan named v0.6.6c, which has since shipped over.
- **Spec 51 rotates accounts** rather than adding a pause, as spec 38 does.
- **The spec 48 click branch is limited to units the play tributes,** rather than stopping propagation on every unit card. The second would change how every unlit unit's click reaches its zone (R3821000).

## Open

- **Slow pool-card fitting:** each card still takes about 75 ms to fit. The split bounds each command, but this deserves its own performance issue.
- **Spec 42 challenge race:** the one-off "challenger did not follow" failure above is unexplained.
